fusions.name: Level Slam
fusions.desc: Slams the butt of the haft down, dealing 16 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Driven Stake
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Drives the fork down on a target up to 4 tiles away for 22 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Anvil Ring
fusions.desc: A ringing challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Flattened Guard
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
